descriptions.notStarted: I lost the sap of Nependeath. I better go talk to Ericsson about it.
descriptions.inProgress: Fortunately Ericsson had some left over from the last time he made them. He wasn't very pleased with the fact that I lost it, but...I think he'll make me another batch.
descriptions.completed: I got a new batch of sap of Nependeath from Ericsson.
